---
title: "Online Appendix: Paper Title"
author: "`r if (isTRUE(params$anonymous)) 'Anonymized for peer review' else '[Author 1], [Affiliation 1]'`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
    number_sections: true
    toc: true
    keep_tex: true
    fig_caption: true
    extra_dependencies:
      - booktabs
      - longtable
      - array
      - float
      - amsmath
      - graphicx
      - setspace
      - geometry
      - threeparttable
      - threeparttablex
      - multirow
      - rotating
geometry: margin=2.5cm
fontsize: 12pt
linestretch: 1.5
bibliography: references.bib
csl: apa.csl
params:
  anonymous: false          # set by R/00_run_all.R (render$anonymous)
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{caption}
  - \captionsetup[table]{skip=6pt}
  - \captionsetup[figure]{skip=6pt}
  - \renewcommand{\thesection}{\Alph{section}}
  - \renewcommand{\thetable}{A\arabic{table}}
  - \renewcommand{\thefigure}{A\arabic{figure}}
---
